entries.secondary_text: Today's topic is Can't wait for the next episode. Make One Yourself by Us let's you make stories with characters you love.

entries.canonical_text: LINE Manga has launched byUs, an AI service for chatting with approved characters and making stories from their works. Readers can imagine what happens next and make fan stories to keep private or share.
